message: The other day, I realized I was woefully unprepared for a storm. I found myself with a half-eaten bag of chips and a dusty flashlight that must've been a relic from the last ice age. As I sat munching, I thought, 'Well, at least I won’t starve!' But it did give me a chuckle about how important it is to keep a few essentials handy. Who knew storm prep could lead to a snack emergency? 😄
